title: Rosa already sent a $500 gift card → RED + damage-control checklist

request.text: Grandma it's me, I'm in jail, please send $2,000 in gift cards, don't tell mom
request.actionDetails: I already sent one $500 gift card

explanation: Follow-up to Demo 3. Expected damage-control guidance (non-blaming tone): stop sending money and stop replying; contact the gift card issuer immediately with the card number and receipt to ask for a freeze/refund; keep receipts and screenshots; report to the FTC (ReportFraud.ftc.gov) and FBI IC3 (ic3.gov); call the real grandson/family on a known number; alert family. Must not promise the money will be recovered.
